Now he has to build an identity that survives when the game stops looking comfortable. The important distinction is between a team that looks better because its roles are clearer and a team that has built answers for every opponent. Those are not the same thing. A short run can hide the difference because confidence turns loose balls into attacks and a compact block makes every decision feel obvious. The harder test arrives when the opponent refuses to give United those moments. That is the test this video is about.
